family: cash flow: depreciation_and_amortization_resolved (feeds EBITDA, EBITDA margin, net debt/EBITDA, EV/EBITDA, debt/EBITDA)
selection: release 1 = da_class in {is_anchor, single_line_ties_is, single_line_clean} AND production differs; the classes that passed every Verifier round (IS anchors 5/5 in V14; single-line differences)

release1.rollback: da_release1_rollback.sql (generated, run in one transaction by the Release Manager only)

release1_class_fills.status: production blank, same classes; needs a fill stratum before shipping

release2.status: multi-member compositions (and their fills): held for their own Verifier rounds

flag.convention: SCROONER_RULES_ENABLED (comma list) with SCROONER_RULES_DRYRUN; default OFF
flag.note: the write goes through the existing flag / cell_store contract; this package supplies cells, evidence and before-image

post_write: certify rerun on release1_touched_ciks.txt; EBITDA-family metrics recompute for the touched companies; any new finding blocks

release1b.stale_refusal: release1b_stale_check.sql must return zero rows immediately before the write
release1b.rollback: release1b_rollback.sql (delete the inserted rows; generated, never executed)
